newsitem.title: USA: Neurex hopes to file NDA for pain treatment.
newsitem.headline: Neurex hopes to file NDA for pain treatment.

text.p: Neurex Corp said Tuesday that an advisory committee of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration endorsed a plan which the company believes will lead to the filing of a New Drug Application for SNX-111.

Neurex Corp said in a release that company representatives recently met with an FDA advisory committee to discuss the clinical development program for SNX-111 in the treatment of chronic malignant and non-malignant pain.

Neurex said that company and FDA representatives discussed program refinements which will be incorporated into the ongoing studies. The company said the size and timing of the program remain unchanged.
Patient accrual, Neurex said, is projected to be completed in 1997 to support an NDA filing three to six months thereafter.
Neurex added that the committee "encouraged the acceleration of the acute surgical pain program" for which SNX-111 is currently in early Phase II clinical trials.
